brief_summary: FGF-21 and insulin are key hormones in the regulation of glucose metabolism. Furthermore, both hormones are influenced by physical activity. The following hypothesis will be tested: FGF-21 is regulated insulin-dependent during exercise.
brief_title: FGF-21 and Exercise in Relation to Insulin Secretion

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy volunteers,persons with T2DM, persons with T1DM

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with contraindications to an exercise ECG or spirometry be excluded from participation in the study.

official_title: FGF-21 During Physical Exercise in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Healthy Controls

primary_outcomes.time_frame: FGF-21 before and 1 h after spiroergometry
